answer: My answer to sybils is Inaugurated cartographer permit with cartographers society attestation — a permit the society renews after map audits — which makes the river of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the spiral is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The trellis grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
